constraints: Keep the behavior of the call unchanged; check the replacement's argument and error handling differences.

steps.instructions: Derive the key with crypto.scrypt and a random salt, generate a random IV, and call createCipheriv or createDecipheriv; existing ciphertext needs a decryption-then-reencrypt migration.
steps.title: Switch to the iv variants

verification.purpose: Run the repository tests when defined.

rule.replacement: crypto.createCipheriv() and crypto.createDecipheriv(), with keys from crypto.scrypt() or crypto.pbkdf2() and random salts
rule.summary: Node.js removed crypto.createCipher() and crypto.createDecipher() because they use a weak key derivation (MD5, no salt) and static IVs (DEP0106, end-of-life since v22.0.0).
rule.title: crypto.createCipher and createDecipher have been removed
